name: attraction-lead-magnet
description: PLUGIN 3 — Lead Magnets & Opt-In Funnels pointed at agents (Week 2, run right after the Partner Offer session). The first lead magnet is chosen from your unique value proposition (honest, cited, dated, no ranking, no trash talk). Then: the next magnet picked from your Agent Avatars and what converted, the magnet written in your voice, the styled PDF brief for Claude Design, the opt-in page and thank-you and book-a-call step, delivery by DM, email, and story (the ManyChat GUIDE keyword), the nurture sequence and weekly newsletter, partnership outreach to lenders, coaches, vendors, and other leaders, your Google Business Profile positioned for attraction, social bios aligned to the funnel (it writes your bios first; the Short-Form System refreshes them in Week 3), and analytics on opt-in rate, list growth, and magnet-to-call conversion. Reads the Agent Attraction Brain; requires Plugin 1 and the Week 2 Partner Offer.
